name: work-with-creators-rate-and-deal
description: Prices a creator you have already vetted. Gives a low and a target fee from median views and the platform's typical cost per 1,000 views, a walk-away ceiling from your goal and margin, and usage rights priced on their own. Checks against real quoted rates and recommends gift, paid, affiliate or a mix, with one line showing the math. Use alone when you already have the creator's recent view numbers, your goal and your unit cost; otherwise run work-with-creators.
